topics.angle: Show the tsconfig baseUrl setting quietly breaking module resolution once TypeScript 7 lands, then the one-line fix of switching to a bare paths map.
topics.why: The Stack Overflow question on this exact deprecation pulled 25,223 views with 4 answers under the typescript tag — the single highest view count of any candidate today, meaning devs are actively hunting for the fix before TS7 ships.

topics.angle: Walk through the '__internal' TypeError that hits right after bumping to Prisma 7, and the actual migration-guide step that fixes it.
topics.why: Two separate Stack Overflow threads about Prisma v7 migration pain appeared this period (5,960 and 2,196 views), showing the same upgrade tripping up multiple node.js/typescript developers independently.

topics.angle: Most developers assume calling setState inside an effect just triggers one clean re-render — React's own cascading-render warning says otherwise.
topics.why: A Stack Overflow question on this exact warning drew 4,891 views under the reactjs tag, showing it's a fresh point of confusion devs are actively searching to understand.

topics.angle: Angular's change detection is assumed to 'just notice' any variable change, but Angular 21's zoneless default means a plain property mutation can render nothing at all.
topics.why: A Stack Overflow question on Angular 21 variable changes not hitting the DOM reached 1,394 views within days under the typescript tag, showing devs hitting the new default without knowing why.

topics.angle: A class declaration that looks broken on screen but is completely standard JavaScript — show why it compiles and what it actually does.
topics.why: A Stack Overflow question asking how this syntax works picked up 1,138 views in days under the javascript tag, meaning plenty of developers don't recognize it on sight.

topics.topic: CSS alpha-only filters changing RGB too
topics.angle: Developers assume an alpha-only filter leaves the RGB channels untouched, but premultiplied alpha math means the colors shift too — show it live.
topics.why: A Stack Overflow question on this exact CSS filter behavior got 1,076 views under the css tag, a surprise for anyone testing it for the first time.

topics.topic: Git doesn't preserve file modification timestamps
topics.angle: Developers assume Git backs up a file's exact mtime like an archive tool — it never stores mtime at all, and every checkout writes the current time.
topics.why: A Stack Overflow question on retaining exact mtimes in a Git repo drew 1,024 views under the git tag, a recurring confusion for anyone expecting Git to behave like a backup tool.

topics.angle: The 'unknown is not assignable to string | number' TypeScript error with react-hook-form and zodResolver has a one-line generic fix most devs miss.
topics.why: A Stack Overflow question on this exact pairing got 483 views under the next.js tag, showing a recurring type mismatch for anyone wiring Zod validation into react-hook-form.

topics.topic: What happens when an AI coding agent's context fills up
topics.angle: A Claude Code session sitting at 99% context looks like it's about to crash — show what actually happens and how older turns get compacted so it keeps going.
topics.why: A YouTube Short on Claude Code at 99% context pulled 236,060 views at 9x this channel's usual, and the same week a dev.to piece on AI agents 'forgetting' covers the identical memory/context problem from another angle.

topics.topic: Incremental Rust rewrite vs big-bang rewrite
topics.angle: Compare the classic 'rewrite it in Rust from scratch' approach against a new tool that rewrites your app piece-by-piece while checking each step against the original's recorded behavior.
topics.why: A new GitHub repo built exactly for this approach hit 7,745 stars in under 14 days, and the same week a dev.to post about rewriting a TypeScript tool to Rust shows the identical migration pattern resonating from a second angle.
